summary: Iteration 28 — full backend + frontend regression on Dynasty Dreams chat overhaul (channels, DMs, messages, unread, mute, commissioner permissions, trade hook, waiver_lost transactions). 11/12 pytest cases pass (1 skipped: no DM exists in chris's league that excludes him because DMs only auto-materialize for the calling user). 7/8 frontend journey checkpoints pass via Playwright. Sole frontend miss is a Playwright selector issue inside the delete-channel flow (the more-actions trigger lookup using closest() didn't resolve correctly in my script) — DELETE is already covered by backend pytest test_commissioner_create_delete_and_default_protected so functionality is verified.

minor.issue: No waiver_lost rows or new metadata fields (competing_claims/winning_team_name/winning_bid) observed in Ice Kings transactions. Endpoint accepts the new types and shape, but no live waiver-processing run has produced rows that exercise the new code paths in this league. Recommend: have main agent run a fresh waiver cycle with multiple competing claims and verify the metadata on the resulting waiver_won + waiver_lost rows.

action_items: OPTIONAL: trigger one fresh weekly waiver run (or manually call the waiver-processing endpoint) so we can validate the new competing_claims / winning_team_name / winning_bid metadata embedding on a live waiver_won row, plus confirm waiver_lost rows surface in /api/leagues/{id}/transactions. The schema and endpoint are correct; only live data is missing.

OPTIONAL: minor httpx test-client gotcha worth documenting — the auth middleware accepts both bearer tokens AND login cookies, and httpx.AsyncClient persists cookies across requests, which can cause a cookie from a prior login to override a Bearer header on subsequent calls. Tests should `c.cookies.clear()` between identity switches. This is auth-middleware behavior, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/chat.py is well-structured: per-league cap (12) enforced, default channels seeded idempotently, DM team_pair sorted for order-independence, mute durations whitelisted, sender's read cursor advanced on POST so no self-unread. Permission check correctly uses commissioner_id + co_commissioners.

/app/backend/routes/chat.py:_is_commissioner reads only `commissioner_id` and `co_commissioners` — does NOT read `commissioner_ids` (plural). Today there is no `commissioner_ids` field populated in Ice Kings, so this works; but if any other league seeds `commissioner_ids` instead, that user would be 403'd. Low priority — matches existing convention.

Frontend Chat.tsx renders cap label (4/12), default channels marked, channel rows expose chat-channel-actions-{id} on hover, mention popup with chat-mention-popup, all per the testid registry in the spec. Toast confirmation on mute/unmute works ('Unmuted' toast observed).
